name: FRSMiniMap
author: Chrystian Farias
description: A 3D minimap and an expanded map on M, with the career events, the GPS route and the other racers.

settings.label: Shape
settings.description: Round, or rectangular as GTA V's

settings.label: Edge
settings.description: Infinite: the map fades out at the edges. Solid: a clear border with an outline

settings.label: Size
settings.description: The minimap's size. It already follows the screen resolution; this scales it further

settings.label: Icons
settings.description: Pins with the mod's icons and colours, or the game's own circles and colours

settings.label: Turn with
settings.description: The map turns with the camera (as in GTA) or with the car

settings.label: Dynamic zoom
settings.description: The zoom opens up with speed, down to a limit

settings.label: Blue GPS arrow
settings.description: The blue marker that floats ahead of the car while the GPS has a route
